assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The organiser has not released official SITE_BOUNDARY or KEY_AREA polygons; the package uses clearly marked provisional geometry (provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false).
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, nodes and phasing are low-confidence design-model values; the nine geometry layers, every metric, all figures and the PDFs must be recomputed from official geometry when it is released.

assumptions.statement: BM0/BENCHMARK ZERO is a conceptual brand and institutional proposition anchored on the Jing-Zhang railway's first autonomous survey and datum setting; the Y/switchback spatial structure is a design reading of the taskbook's three areas and two wings, not a statutory land-use conclusion.
assumptions.impact: Spatial, brand, event and policy propositions are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen; they do not imply government approval, investment, or engineering feasibility.

assumptions.statement: public_space.geojson is constructed by differencing the green_space geometry, so the two layers are mathematically disjoint and green_ratio plus public_space_ratio never double-count.
assumptions.impact: The two formal ratios are independently recomputable and additive.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual prototypes (379,000 m2, 10 clusters) expressing functional intent; they are not surveyed footprints, approved buildings, or retain/renovate/demolish conclusions.
assumptions.impact: No parcel-level demolition, construction or FAR conclusion is drawn; FAR and height stay unknown until the organiser releases regulatory controls.

assumptions.statement: Site anchoring is treated as a qualitative argument, not a measured statistic. The proposal's core claims rest on three independently verifiable site facts: (1) the Jing-Zhang railway is China's first trunk line built through autonomous survey and datum setting (see official announcement); (2) the site is a 1:7 linear rail corridor (1.4 km wide, 9.7 km long, ratio 0.14), and the Y structure's physical precondition is built on that fact; (3) the three key areas (Zhongzhiyuan, Origin community, Dazhongsi) are explicitly named in the taskbook. Moved to any site that does not hold all three facts at once, the claims lose or shift their meaning. The previously published numeric site_anchor_dependency_ratio=1.0 is removed; it was a single-author coding, could not be cross-checked against an external corpus, and is not used as evidence in the current submission.
assumptions.impact: Provides the narrative anchor for the originality dimension; bound to a finite, verifiable fact set, not a synthetic index. Does not establish any exclusive or globally first-of-its-kind claim.
